title: LiteTech
body:
# This is LiteTech!

I have long wanted to dive into the world of oritech and its release was a great reason. That's why I made this build and want to share it with you!

**LiteTech** is an easy and uncluttered adventure to help you learn the oritech mod. Modpack will be supplemented as necessary, the main goal will be to improve the basic gameplay without making major changes to the mechanics of minecraft. 

## Main mods

**oritech** - a technology-focused mod, with animated machinery, diverse processing options, and 
plenty of new mechanics and equipment

**Immersive Aircraft** - a bunch of rustic aircraft to travel, transport, and explore!

**Man of Many Planes** - A set of additional aircraft for Immersive Aircraft with Create support in mind

**Terralith** - 100 new biomes consisting of both realism and light fantasy, using just Vanilla blocks
